summary: The Facilities and Finance Nominating Panel interviewed candidates at its meeting on April 11, 2018 and has recommended one public member to City Council for appointment to the Legacy Fund Allocations Committee.
decided: City Council on April 24, 25, 26 and 27, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council appoint the following candidate to the Legacy Fund Allocations Committee, at pleasure of Council, for a term of office ending on April 26, 2021, and until a successor is appointed: - Marisha Roman 2. City Council direct that Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (April 3, 3018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Legacy Fund Allocations Committee. Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (April 3, 3018) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety in accordance with the provisions of the City of Toronto Act, 2006 as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Legacy Fund Allocations Committee.

motions.desc: Majority required - CC39.3 - Adopt the item
